scope: Every listed callable individually source-reasoned; interface declarations reviewed as contracts, not implementations

symbols.reasoning: Description getter contract exposes a human destination label for logs/errors. Implementations can include host, directory or queue name; interface itself does not redact or require any value. No getter body or hardware effect exists here.
symbols.side_effects: None in declaration; implementation getter effects separate
symbols.trust_boundaries: Station HTTP/filesystem/configuration and hardware acceptance are distinct trust boundaries; see individual reasoning
symbols.database: No direct SQL in PrintAgent; HTTP reporting/authentication may write server records if actually invoked
symbols.printing_ui: No physical verification performed; queuing, transport acceptance and paper completion must remain distinct
symbols.performance: Sequential processing except explicitly described loops/HTTP waits; disk cost and retry limits reasoned individually
symbols.duplicates_conflicts: Physical retry identity and HTTP report idempotency are distinct; no cross-machine lease
symbols.issues_hypotheses: Could reveal local paths/hosts in server error logs; no credentials should be embedded
symbols.tests_missing: Isolated fake transport/server or owned temp-file tests; no real auth/DB/printer actions. Specific missing cases stated in reasoning
symbols.review_method: Actual source reasoning; no runtime verification
